description: Two bills on the Bishopsgate post

participation.context: Read both bills and walked on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: On your way up to the Theatre you stopped at the Bishopsgate post and read the two new bills, the Rose's and your own company's.

title: Read the Rose's bill and the Theatre's bill

participation.context: Refused a headcount, walked Navarre's entrances, and kept the other plan unsaid.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted the early yard as timber and named noon and two.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Asked for the length of the boards and left the hush for the afternoon.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Set Sam on the breath, not on the word.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Sang the cuckoo clear and stopped when he was told once more was enough.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

participation.context: Spoke the messenger's four words in black, slowly.
participation.name: John Sincler

participation.context: Kept the plot on the nail and would not pad the messenger.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

relations.quote: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word.
I am counting them as timber.

story.body: You walked the entrances on a stage twice the Cross Keys. You heard Sam sing, clear. You reported the two bills and refused a morning number. You played Navarre when the trumpet came.

relations.quote: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word.
I am counting them as timber.

title: Walked the stage and played Navarre

participation.context: Refused to turn her stair or the house into a receipt.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the gallery's fifty-two shillings and the crowd that paid them.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Called the afternoon two thousand a house, and counted them as timber.
participation.name: James Burbage

story.body: You let Margery Pell keep her figure as hers. You let two thousand stay a house. You did not write either into a Rose book.
